scenario: LHS bindings are in scope in a continuation body (LCCO.5.1): an `on response` body logging the outer binding `{s.entity_id}` compiles, so the name resolves there. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not observe the `$CaptureBindings_<rule>_c<N>` schema or its binding slot.
rules_ds:
schema NotifySendReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    status: Int

service notify.send:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response NotifySendReply

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule alert_rule:
    Sensor s
->
    call notify.send entity_id: s.entity_id cooldown: 30_s
        on response.status == 200:
            log info "sent to {s.entity_id}"
